author: Stahly
description:
The Ogor Mawtribes are hungry for a new era, and Games Workshop has brought a near-complete refresh of the range to the Mortal Realms. We're unboxing the Ogor Mawtribes Army Set, which brings 16 brand-new miniatures alongside a new Battletome. In this review, we go through every kit in detail with high-res sprue images throughout, and take a close look inside the new Battletome, including a full rundown of which older models have survived the cut.

The post The Ogor Mawtribes Army Set is a feast for the eyes (unboxing & review) appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: The Ogor Mawtribes Army Set is a feast for the eyes (unboxing & review)
